requirements.verify:
bash -lc 'pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:4111 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; fi; out=$(timeout 20 bun packages/platform/src/index.ts 2>&1); ec=$?; printf "%s
" "$out"; echo exit_code=$ec; printf "%s
" "$out" | rg -q "Starting Mastra service on :4111" && ! printf "%s
" "$out" | rg -qi "Failed to start server|module not found" && [[ $ec -eq 124 || $ec -eq 143 ]]'
